assumptions.name: Days past due that count as delinquency
assumptions.rationale: First delinquency bucket; an early warning makes sense before 60 or 90 days.

assumptions.name: Delinquency alert horizons
assumptions.rationale: Stated verbatim in the client brief.

assumptions.name: Churn definition
assumptions.rationale: The client asks for 3 months' lead time; a natural maturity is not a decision that can be retained.

assumptions.name: Preferred segment
assumptions.rationale: Top 10% of clients by exposure (12,500 clients), matching the synthetic churn data (200 rows x 62.5). Tenure is not usable as the criterion because 12% of tenure_months is missing.

assumptions.name: Feature history window
assumptions.rationale: Covers a full annual cycle and its seasonality.

assumptions.name: No-intervention control group
assumptions.rationale: Measures the effect of the action without leaving many clients unmanaged.

assumptions.name: Share of exposure lost if the event occurs
assumptions.rationale: Upper-bound scenario; 58,800M and 18,200M are exposure, not loss. The simulator allows lowering it.

assumptions.name: Alert frequency and capacity K
assumptions.rationale: Collections working rhythm; K moves in the simulator and K* comes from the calculation.

assumptions.name: Action effectiveness and cost per contact
assumptions.rationale: Test-case values with no source; declared illustrative.

assumptions.name: Reconciliation tolerance
assumptions.rationale: Rounding of the published figure; already used in reconcile.py.

assumptions.name: Condition to beat the baseline
assumptions.rationale: The criterion is measured in COP, not only in classification metrics.

assumptions.name: RAW retention period
assumptions.rationale: Depends on FinBank's data policy (Ley 1581); we do not set it because we do not give legal advice.

assumptions.name: Charter budget, contingency reserve and hours
assumptions.rationale: Charter table 1: management 30 + business and data 40 + modeling 60 + validation 30 + contingency 20. BAC = ceiling - contingency (160M); the reserve is kept apart so that its use is visible. The rate is derived (180M / 1,620 h) and only rounded on screen.

assumptions.name: Academic hours scale
assumptions.rationale: GMAC has 2 credits = 12 h per person per sprint; the Charter plans 90 consultant hours per person per sprint. k = 90 / 12 = 7.5, so one logged hour = 7.5 consultant hours.

assumptions.name: Approved change requests
assumptions.rationale: CR-01 (web dashboard, US-10) is approved for (8 + 2) h x 7.5 x rate = 8.33M. Control of change moves that amount from the contingency reserve to the BAC of Sprint 3.
